spots.name: Observation Point
spots.tip: A mapped viewpoint facing west. Good for sunset. Arrive 30 minutes early to scout foreground.

spots.name: North boat cove overlook
spots.tip: A mapped viewpoint. Check which way it faces: east for sunrise, west for sunset. Arrive 30 minutes early to scout foreground.

spots.name: Main Beach
spots.tip: Low tide and wet sand give reflections at sunset. Check the tide table and never turn your back on the waves. Mapped as private or no access: check before you go.
